title: TD Talk: a damaged or silent voice recording is no longer sent
text: A voice note that was only the last second of a longer recording could be sent and could not be played by anyone. Now TD Talk checks the recording first: if it is damaged or the microphone heard nothing, nothing is sent and you are told to record again. The server also refuses a damaged voice file, and while you record you see a sound bar and a warning if no sound is coming in.
points: Record a voice note in TD Talk: a sound bar moves while you speak
Record with the microphone muted: after 3 seconds a red "No sound yet" warning shows, and sending says nothing was sent
Record and send a normal note: it plays as before
stepsTitle: What happens when you send a voice note

steps.name: You record
steps.detail: A sound bar moves while you speak; with a muted microphone a red warning shows after 3 seconds.

steps.name: You press send
steps.detail: TD Talk checks the recording is whole and the microphone heard sound.

steps.name: If it is damaged or silent
steps.detail: Nothing is sent and you are told to record again.

steps.name: If it is fine
steps.detail: The note is sent and plays as before.
